source_id: UC-GYM-001 - Create club with valid data
purpose: Verify main success scenario of club creation.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated and authorized; Valid student records exist for coordinator and co-coordinator; Valid faculty record exists for Club Faculty Councillor
action_or_input: As Student Admin submit club name, description, an allowed category, valid coordinator, valid co-coordinator, valid Club Faculty Councillor
expected_result: A new club exists with status open, referencing the selected coordinator, co-coordinator and councillor; success confirmation is returned.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 - Reject invalid coordinator
purpose: Verify invalid coordinator is identified and club is not created.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated and authorized; Valid co-coordinator and councillor exist
action_or_input: Submit creation with a coordinator identity that does not resolve to a valid student record
expected_result: System identifies the coordinator assignment as invalid; no club is created.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 - Reject invalid co-coordinator
purpose: Verify invalid co-coordinator is identified and club is not created.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated and authorized; Valid coordinator and councillor exist
action_or_input: Submit creation with a co-coordinator identity that does not resolve to a valid student record
expected_result: System identifies the co-coordinator assignment as invalid; no club is created.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 - Reject invalid Club Faculty Councillor
purpose: Verify invalid faculty councillor is identified and club is not created.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated and authorized; Valid coordinator and co-coordinator exist
action_or_input: Submit creation with a councillor identity that does not resolve to a valid faculty record
expected_result: System identifies the councillor assignment as invalid; no club is created.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 - Correct an invalid assignment and resubmit
purpose: Verify the alternative flow allows correction without a club having been created.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated and authorized
action_or_input: Submit creation with an invalid leader; Confirm no club exists; Resubmit with the invalid assignment corrected
expected_result: First submission creates nothing; corrected submission creates exactly one club with status open.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 - Non-Student-Admin cannot create club
purpose: Verify authorization precondition for club creation.
preconditions: An authenticated user who is not a Student Admin (e.g., a Student)
action_or_input: Attempt to create a club with otherwise valid data
expected_result: No club is created. Exact rejection response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 - Storage failure leaves no club
purpose: Verify exception flow when data cannot be stored.
preconditions: Valid creation request; Ability to force a persistence failure in the test environment
action_or_input: Submit the valid request while storage is made to fail
expected_result: No club (and no partial club record treated as successful) exists; the system reports failure.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 - Category outside allowed set
purpose: Probe handling of a category that is not an allowed club category.
preconditions: Student Admin authenticated and authorized; Valid leaders and councillor
action_or_input: Submit creation with a category value not in the allowed set
expected_result: Not explicitly specified. Step 2 requires an 'allowed' category; the UC does not state the outcome for a disallowed one. Assertion limited to: the outcome is recorded for review (see ambiguity AMB-02).

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Book session with all fields incl. poster
purpose: Verify main success scenario for session booking.
preconditions: Actor is coordinator/co-coordinator of a confirmed club; A configured venue exists with no sessions/events on the chosen date
action_or_input: Submit venue, date, valid start/end time, description and a poster
expected_result: Session is stored; student notification is initiated; booking is confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Book session without poster
purpose: Verify poster is optional for sessions.
preconditions: Same as TC-UC-009
action_or_input: Submit all fields except the poster
expected_result: Session is created, notification initiated, booking confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Partial overlap with existing session
purpose: Verify conflict rejection against an existing session on same venue/date.
preconditions: Existing session at venue V on date D from 10:00 to 12:00
action_or_input: Book session at V on D from 11:00 to 13:00
expected_result: Booking is rejected and actor is asked to select another slot; no new session recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Overlap with existing event (cross-type)
purpose: Verify session booking is checked against events, not only sessions.
preconditions: Existing event at venue V on date D from 10:00 to 12:00
action_or_input: Book session at V on D from 11:00 to 13:00
expected_result: Booking is rejected; no new session recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Identical slot as existing session
purpose: Boundary: exact same venue/date/start/end.
preconditions: Existing session at V on D from 10:00 to 12:00
action_or_input: Book session at V on D from 10:00 to 12:00
expected_result: Booking is rejected as an overlap; no new session recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Requested slot contained within existing slot
purpose: Boundary: new slot fully inside an existing one.
preconditions: Existing session at V on D from 10:00 to 14:00
action_or_input: Book session at V on D from 11:00 to 12:00
expected_result: Booking is rejected as an overlap; no new session recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Same time at a different venue
purpose: Verify conflict check is scoped to the same venue.
preconditions: Existing session at venue V1 on D 10:00-12:00; Second configured venue V2
action_or_input: Book session at V2 on D 10:00-12:00
expected_result: Session is created and confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Same time on a different date
purpose: Verify conflict check is scoped to the same date.
preconditions: Existing session at V on D1 10:00-12:00
action_or_input: Book session at V on D2 10:00-12:00
expected_result: Session is created and confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - End time before start time
purpose: Verify invalid time range rejection.
preconditions: Actor is club head of a confirmed club
action_or_input: Book session with start 12:00 and end 10:00
expected_result: No successful booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Invalid (non-configured) venue
purpose: Verify invalid venue rejection.
preconditions: Actor is club head of a confirmed club
action_or_input: Book session with a venue that is not configured
expected_result: No successful booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Non-head of the club cannot book session
purpose: Verify only the applicable coordinator/co-coordinator can book.
preconditions: Authenticated user who is a Student or a Club Head of a different club
action_or_input: Attempt to book a session for the club
expected_result: No session is created. Exact rejection response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Club not confirmed (open)
purpose: Probe precondition 'club exists and is confirmed'.
preconditions: Club with status open whose head is the actor
action_or_input: Attempt to book a session
expected_result: Not explicitly specified. Record the outcome; stated precondition implies booking should not proceed (see AMB-04).

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Notification failure before acceptance
purpose: Verify exception flow: no booking recorded when notification processing fails before acceptance.
preconditions: Valid booking request; Ability to force notification-service failure
action_or_input: Submit valid booking while notification processing fails
expected_result: No successful booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Storage failure on session
purpose: Verify exception flow when the session cannot be stored.
preconditions: Valid booking request; Ability to force a storage failure
action_or_input: Submit valid booking while storage fails
expected_result: No successful booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Retry with another slot after conflict
purpose: Verify alternative flow: actor selects another slot after rejection.
preconditions: Existing session at V on D 10:00-12:00
action_or_input: Attempt 11:00-13:00 and observe rejection; Rebook at V on D 12:00-13:00 or at another non-overlapping time
expected_result: First attempt rejected with nothing stored; second attempt creates a session and confirms. (Choose a slot clearly non-overlapping, e.g., 14:00-15:00, to avoid the adjacency ambiguity.)

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Adjacent slots (end equals existing start)
purpose: Boundary probe: touching but not overlapping slots.
preconditions: Existing session at V on D 10:00-12:00
action_or_input: Book session at V on D 12:00-13:00
expected_result: Not specified whether touching slots are 'overlapping'. Outcome recorded for clarification (see AMB-05).

source_id: UC-GYM-002 - Start time equals end time
purpose: Boundary probe: zero-length time range.
preconditions: Actor is club head of a confirmed club
action_or_input: Book session with start 10:00 and end 10:00
expected_result: Not specified whether a zero-length range is valid. Outcome recorded for clarification (see AMB-06).

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Book event with valid data
purpose: Verify main success scenario for event booking.
preconditions: Actor is coordinator/co-coordinator of a confirmed club; Valid faculty context; Configured venue free on date
action_or_input: Submit event name, faculty context, venue, date, start/end time, poster, description
expected_result: Event is stored; student notification initiated; booking confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Event overlaps existing session (cross-type)
purpose: Verify event booking is checked against sessions.
preconditions: Existing session at V on D 10:00-12:00
action_or_input: Book event at V on D 11:00-13:00
expected_result: Booking rejected; actor asked to choose another slot; no event stored.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Event overlaps existing event
purpose: Verify event-vs-event conflict rejection.
preconditions: Existing event at V on D 10:00-12:00
action_or_input: Book event at V on D 11:00-13:00
expected_result: Booking rejected; no event stored.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Invalid faculty reference
purpose: Verify rejection of an invalid faculty reference.
preconditions: Actor is club head of a confirmed club
action_or_input: Book event with a faculty reference that is not valid
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Invalid time range for event
purpose: Verify invalid time range rejection.
preconditions: Actor is club head of a confirmed club
action_or_input: Book event with end time before start time
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Invalid venue for event
purpose: Verify invalid venue rejection.
preconditions: Actor is club head of a confirmed club
action_or_input: Book event with a non-configured venue
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Non-head cannot book event
purpose: Verify authorization for event booking.
preconditions: Authenticated Student or Club Head of another club
action_or_input: Attempt to book an event for the club
expected_result: No event is created. Exact rejection response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Club not confirmed (open) cannot book event
purpose: Probe precondition 'club exists and is confirmed'.
preconditions: Club with status open, actor is its head
action_or_input: Attempt to book an event
expected_result: Not explicitly specified; precondition implies booking should not proceed (see AMB-04).

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Storage failure on event
purpose: Verify exception flow when event cannot be stored.
preconditions: Valid request; Ability to force storage failure
action_or_input: Submit valid event booking while storage fails
expected_result: No successful event booking is recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-003 - Same time at a different venue allowed for events
purpose: Verify event conflict check is scoped to same venue.
preconditions: Existing event at V1 on D 10:00-12:00; Second configured venue V2
action_or_input: Book event at V2 on D 10:00-12:00
expected_result: Event is created and confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 - Apply for membership to confirmed club
purpose: Verify main success scenario of membership application.
preconditions: Student authenticated; Confirmed club exists; Student has no prior application to it
action_or_input: Select the club; Enter achievements/description; Submit
expected_result: Application recorded for the authenticated student with status open; submission confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 - Duplicate application to same club
purpose: Verify duplicate rejection leaves existing application unchanged.
preconditions: Student already has an open application to club C
action_or_input: Submit another application to C with different description
expected_result: Duplicate is rejected; the existing application is unchanged; no second application exists.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 - Apply to a different club with an existing application
purpose: Verify alternative flow allowing applications to different clubs.
preconditions: Student has an open application to club C1; Confirmed club C2 exists
action_or_input: Apply to C2
expected_result: New open application to C2 is created; the C1 application is unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 - Apply to a club that is not confirmed
purpose: Probe precondition 'selected club exists and is confirmed'.
preconditions: Club with status open exists
action_or_input: Attempt to apply to the open club
expected_result: Not explicitly specified; precondition implies the application should not be accepted (see AMB-04).

source_id: UC-GYM-004 - Unauthenticated user cannot apply
purpose: Verify authentication precondition.
preconditions: No authenticated session
action_or_input: Attempt to submit an application
expected_result: No application is created. Exact response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 - Available clubs offered for application are confirmed clubs
purpose: Verify step 1: confirmed clubs are displayed/selectable.
preconditions: One confirmed club and one open club exist
action_or_input: Request the list of clubs available for application
expected_result: The confirmed club is available for selection; the open club is not stated to be available.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Approve a single application with remarks
purpose: Verify main success scenario.
preconditions: Actor is club head of club C; Open application to C exists
action_or_input: Approve the application with remarks
expected_result: Application status changes open to confirmed; remarks stored; approval confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Approve without remarks
purpose: Verify remarks are optional ('may enter').
preconditions: Same as TC-UC-042
action_or_input: Approve the application without remarks
expected_result: Application becomes confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Approve multiple applications in one interaction
purpose: Verify bulk approval alternative flow.
preconditions: Actor is club head of C; Three open applications to C
action_or_input: Select all three and approve
expected_result: All three become confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Mixed batch: independent evaluation
purpose: Verify each application is evaluated independently.
preconditions: Actor is club head of C; Two open applications and one already confirmed application to C
action_or_input: Submit all three in one approval interaction
expected_result: The two open applications become confirmed; the already-confirmed application is not changed.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Application belonging to another club is not changed
purpose: Verify cross-club approval is blocked.
preconditions: Actor is club head of C1; Open application exists for club C2
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the C2 application as C1 head
expected_result: The application is not changed (remains open).

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Non-club-head cannot approve
purpose: Verify only the applicable club head can approve.
preconditions: Authenticated Student with open application to C present
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the application
expected_result: The application remains open. Exact response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Approve an application that is no longer open
purpose: Verify re-approval of a confirmed application does nothing.
preconditions: Application to C with status confirmed (with prior remarks)
action_or_input: Attempt to approve again with different remarks
expected_result: Application is not changed (status and stored remarks unchanged).

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Pending list scoped to actor's club
purpose: Verify step 1 shows pending applications for the actor's club only.
preconditions: Open applications exist for clubs C1 and C2; Actor is head of C1
action_or_input: Request pending applications
expected_result: Only open applications for C1 are shown.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 - Apply then approve lifecycle (BW-GYM-01)
purpose: Verify membership workflow from open to confirmed.
preconditions: Confirmed club C; Student S; Club head of C
action_or_input: S applies to C; Verify status open; Club head approves; Verify status confirmed
expected_result: Application transitions open to confirmed with remarks stored.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - Create poll with valid definition
purpose: Verify main success scenario.
preconditions: Actor is club head; Valid batch/branch target groups exist
action_or_input: Submit title, description, expiry, two or more choices, target batch and branch
expected_result: Active poll with choices and target audience exists; notification initiated for students in the target groups; creation confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - Poll with one choice
purpose: Boundary below the minimum choice count.
preconditions: Actor is club head
action_or_input: Submit poll with exactly one choice
expected_result: Poll is not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - Poll with zero choices
purpose: Negative: no choices.
preconditions: Actor is club head
action_or_input: Submit poll with no choices
expected_result: Poll is not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - Poll with exactly two choices
purpose: Boundary at the minimum choice count.
preconditions: Actor is club head
action_or_input: Submit valid poll with exactly two choices
expected_result: Poll is created with both choices.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - All branches for a batch
purpose: Verify alternative flow: a branch selection representing all branches.
preconditions: Actor is club head; All-branches option configured for a batch
action_or_input: Create poll targeting the batch with the all-branches option
expected_result: Poll is created and targets students of that batch across all branches.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - Invalid target information
purpose: Verify invalid target groups block creation.
preconditions: Actor is club head
action_or_input: Submit otherwise valid poll with an invalid batch/branch target
expected_result: Poll is not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - Notifications reach only target-group students
purpose: Verify notification audience follows the target selection.
preconditions: Students inside and outside the selected batch/branch
action_or_input: Create poll for the selected batch/branch; Inspect initiated notifications
expected_result: Notifications are initiated for students in the selected target groups; none for students outside them.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - Non-club-head cannot create poll
purpose: Verify authorization.
preconditions: Authenticated Student
action_or_input: Attempt to create a poll
expected_result: No poll is created. Exact response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 - Poll targeting multiple batch/branch groups
purpose: Verify multiple target groups are supported ('target groups').
preconditions: Actor is club head; Students in two target groups
action_or_input: Create poll with two target groups
expected_result: Poll is created and students of both groups are in the target audience.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 - Cast a vote in eligible active poll
purpose: Verify main success scenario.
preconditions: Authenticated student in target group; Active unexpired poll; Student has not voted
action_or_input: Select one choice and submit
expected_result: One vote recorded; chosen choice tally increases by one; student recorded as having voted; success confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 - Duplicate vote rejected
purpose: Verify one vote per student.
preconditions: Student has already voted in the poll
action_or_input: Attempt to vote again (same or different choice)
expected_result: Vote is rejected; tally unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 - Ineligible student cannot vote
purpose: Verify target-group eligibility.
preconditions: Student not in any target group of the poll
action_or_input: Attempt to vote
expected_result: Vote is rejected; tally unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 - Vote in expired poll
purpose: Verify expired poll is not active.
preconditions: Eligible student; Poll whose expiration date has passed
action_or_input: Attempt to vote
expected_result: Vote is rejected; tally unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 - Unauthenticated user cannot vote
purpose: Verify authentication precondition.
preconditions: No authenticated session; Active poll
action_or_input: Attempt to vote
expected_result: No vote is recorded. Exact response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 - Multiple eligible students vote independently
purpose: Verify tally aggregates one vote per eligible student.
preconditions: Active poll with choices A and B; Three eligible students
action_or_input: Student 1 and 2 vote A, student 3 votes B
expected_result: Tally is A=2, B=1.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 - Poll presented with its choices
purpose: Verify step 1 presentation of an eligible active poll.
preconditions: Active poll available to student
action_or_input: Student opens the poll
expected_result: Poll and its choices are presented.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 - Poll lifecycle: create, vote, repeat vote (BW-GYM-02)
purpose: Verify end-to-end polling workflow.
preconditions: Club head; eligible and ineligible students
action_or_input: Club head creates poll for a target group; Eligible student votes; Same student votes again; Ineligible student votes
expected_result: Poll created; first vote counted; second vote and ineligible vote rejected; final tally shows one vote.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 - Change leadership with valid students
purpose: Verify main success scenario.
preconditions: Actor is current Club Head of club C; Two valid student records distinct from current leaders
action_or_input: Submit new coordinator and co-coordinator for C
expected_result: Club references the new coordinator and co-coordinator only; change confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 - Invalid proposed coordinator
purpose: Verify leadership unchanged on invalid coordinator.
preconditions: Actor is current Club Head
action_or_input: Submit invalid coordinator with valid co-coordinator
expected_result: Current leadership remains unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 - Invalid proposed co-coordinator
purpose: Verify leadership unchanged on invalid co-coordinator.
preconditions: Actor is current Club Head
action_or_input: Submit valid coordinator with invalid co-coordinator
expected_result: Current leadership remains unchanged (including the coordinator).

source_id: UC-GYM-008 - Proposed leader is not a student
purpose: Verify both proposed leaders must be students.
preconditions: Actor is current Club Head; A faculty (non-student) identity exists
action_or_input: Propose the faculty identity as coordinator
expected_result: Current leadership remains unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 - Unauthorized actor cannot change leadership
purpose: Verify authorization.
preconditions: Authenticated user who is not a current Club Head of C
action_or_input: Attempt to change leadership of C
expected_result: Current leadership remains unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 - Failed change keeps existing leadership
purpose: Verify minimal guarantee when the change fails.
preconditions: Valid request; Ability to force a failure during update
action_or_input: Submit change while the update fails
expected_result: Existing leadership remains intact.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 - Superseded designations retired, new ones recorded
purpose: Verify current designations are consistent after change.
preconditions: Club C with current coordinator and co-coordinator
action_or_input: Change leadership; Inspect current leadership designations
expected_result: New coordinator/co-coordinator hold current designations; previous leaders no longer hold current leadership designations.

source_id: UC-GYM-008 - Former head loses Club Head authority
purpose: Verify the consequence of retiring old designations.
preconditions: Leadership change completed for C
action_or_input: Former coordinator attempts a Club Head action for C (e.g., approve membership)
expected_result: Action is not permitted; the new coordinator can perform it.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 - Submit valid budget request
purpose: Verify main success scenario.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club
action_or_input: Enter purpose, positive amount, supporting file, description; submit
expected_result: Request is stored with status open; submission confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 - Amount of zero
purpose: Boundary: smallest non-negative amount.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club
action_or_input: Submit with amount 0 and valid file
expected_result: Request is accepted and stored as open (0 is non-negative).

source_id: UC-GYM-009 - Negative amount
purpose: Verify negative amount rejection.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club
action_or_input: Submit with amount -100 and valid file
expected_result: Request is rejected and not stored as a valid submission.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 - Amount just below zero
purpose: Boundary: smallest negative value.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club
action_or_input: Submit with amount -0.01 and valid file
expected_result: Request is rejected and not stored.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 - Missing supporting file
purpose: Verify required file enforcement.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head of confirmed club
action_or_input: Submit with valid amount and no file
expected_result: Request is rejected and not stored.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 - Non-club-head cannot request budget
purpose: Verify authorization.
preconditions: Authenticated Student or Club Head of another club
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a budget request for the club
expected_result: No budget request is stored. Exact response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-009 - Club not confirmed (open) cannot request budget
purpose: Probe precondition 'club exists and is confirmed'.
preconditions: Open club whose head is the actor
action_or_input: Attempt a budget request
expected_result: Not explicitly specified; precondition implies the request should not proceed (see AMB-04).

source_id: UC-GYM-010 - Submit valid event report
purpose: Verify main success scenario.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head; Event/activity has occurred; Valid student incharge exists
action_or_input: Enter club, student incharge, event name, description, date/time; upload report file; submit
expected_result: Report is stored and available in the club repository; submission confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 - Missing report file
purpose: Verify required file enforcement.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head
action_or_input: Submit all fields without the report/details file
expected_result: Report is not accepted.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 - Invalid student incharge reference
purpose: Verify invalid required references reject the report.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head
action_or_input: Submit with a student incharge that is not a valid student
expected_result: Report is not accepted.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 - Non-club-head cannot submit report
purpose: Verify authorization.
preconditions: Authenticated Student or Club Head of another club
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a report for the club
expected_result: No report is stored. Exact response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 - Report for an event that has not occurred
purpose: Probe precondition 'relevant event/activity has occurred'.
preconditions: Actor is Club Head; Event date in the future
action_or_input: Submit report with a future date/time
expected_result: Not specified how the system verifies or enforces this precondition (see AMB-09). Outcome recorded only.

source_id: UC-GYM-010 - Submitted report reviewable by councillor
purpose: Verify cross-UC hand-off: a stored report is available to the assigned councillor.
preconditions: Club C with assigned Club Faculty Councillor F; Club head of C
action_or_input: Club head submits valid report; F lists reports for C and opens it
expected_result: The report appears in F's list; metadata and file are available.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 - Approve an open club
purpose: Verify main success scenario.
preconditions: Student Admin authorized; Club with status open
action_or_input: Approve the club
expected_result: Status changes from open to confirmed; approval confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 - Approve a club that is not open
purpose: Verify no transition for non-open club.
preconditions: Club already confirmed
action_or_input: Attempt to approve
expected_result: No approval transition occurs; status remains confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 - Non-Student-Admin cannot approve club
purpose: Verify authorization.
preconditions: Open club exists; Authenticated Club Head or Student
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the club
expected_result: Club remains open. Exact response is not specified.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 - Approval update failure retains status
purpose: Verify failure guarantee.
preconditions: Open club; Ability to force update failure
action_or_input: Approve while update fails
expected_result: Club retains status open.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 - Club lifecycle: create, approve, book (BW-GYM-03)
purpose: Verify the club creation/approval workflow and its effect on bookings.
preconditions: Student Admin; valid leaders and councillor
action_or_input: Student Admin creates club (open); Club head attempts booking while open and observe; Student Admin approves club; Club head books a session at a free slot
expected_result: Club is open after creation, confirmed after approval; booking succeeds after approval. Behavior of the pre-approval booking attempt is unspecified (AMB-04), so only the post-approval outcome is asserted.

source_id: UC-GYM-012 - Councillor lists and opens a report
purpose: Verify main success scenario.
preconditions: Faculty user is assigned Club Faculty Councillor of C; At least one submitted report exists for C
action_or_input: Open club report area; Select a report
expected_result: Submitted reports for C are listed; selected report's metadata is displayed and its file is made available.

source_id: UC-GYM-012 - Unassigned faculty denied access
purpose: Verify exception flow: faculty not assigned to the club.
